step: final_connection.md 步骤 2 — KU Leuven 转换

command.pilot_s1: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m scripts.auditory.convert --kind kuleuven --input datasets/AAD-KULeuven/S1.mat --stimuli datasets/AAD-KULeuven/stimuli --metadata datasets/AAD-KULeuven/metadata.json --out datasets/AAD-KULeuven/converted/S1
command.remaining_subjects: pwsh -NoProfile -File tmp/convert_rest.ps1  # S2..S16, 4 concurrent Start-Process workers, each running the same CLI with --input datasets/AAD-KULeuven/<S>.mat --out datasets/AAD-KULeuven/converted/<S>
command.note: the driver loop is a throwaway pool script, not a committed artifact

loader_change.summary: load_kuleuven derived a dry stimulus name for every trials[i].stimuli entry before touching the disk, via the new dry_stimulus_name() helper, and resolves it with the new resolve_stimulus() helper (exact path first, single rglob match as a fallback). It no longer calls rglob() with the hrtf name from the .mat, so it no longer requires that name to be present or unique. Candidate ordering, the attended-track lookup, group, timestamps, and every AuditoryTrial validation are unchanged.
loader_change.before: names = sorted(str(name) for name in np.atleast_1d(record.stimuli))
loader_change.after: names = sorted(dry_stimulus_name(name) for name in np.atleast_1d(record.stimuli))
loader_change.corrected_premise: The plan's stated failure mode (rglob uniqueness breaking because rep_part1_track1_hrtf.wav appears in 3 trials) does NOT reproduce: each name occurs once on disk and rglob is called per trial, so the old loader runs to completion, exit 0, on real S1. The real defect is silent: the old loader built the reference envelope from the hrtf rendering, contradicting the dataset's own recipe.

naming_derivation.channel_names_source: mne.channels.make_standard_montage('biosemi64').ch_names; column j of EegData is named by index j of that list
naming_derivation.evidence: the dataset ships no channel-location file; the published preprocess_data.m sets params.rereference = 'Cz' and subtracts EegData(:,48), and the standard order places Cz at index 48

envelope_source.rule: trailing _hrtf becomes _dry; rep_ prefix preserved; _dry is idempotent
envelope_source.authority: README.txt.txt: envelopes 'were extracted only from part{part}_track{track}_dry.wav files'; preprocess_data.m loads <name>_dry.mat after truncating the name to 12 or 16 characters

verification.conclusion: converted audio is bit-identical to the DRY stimulus and differs from the hrtf rendering, so the published envelope recipe reached the artifacts

observations_for_step_4.audio_longer_than_eeg: the loader keeps the full stimulus and truncates only to the shorter of the two candidates (min(len(track))), so audio is longer than EEG in every trial; the README recommends truncating the audio to the EEG length, and preprocess_data.m does exactly that for envelopes. This step did not change that behaviour because it is existing loader semantics; the audit step should decide the contract.
observations_for_step_4.eeg_amplitude: peak |EegData| is a few hundred (e.g. 325.6 for S1 trial 0), which reads as microvolts rather than volts; step 4 should confirm the unit against AuditoryProcessor's source_unit_exponent=-6 contract before training.
